scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail false "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "cd apps/ai && uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8001"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:railway: npx prisma generate --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
